rules.text: Enter the Dust Veil chakra stance as a Bonus action (the clan's stance item). One particle type (another, or Potency I and II of one, at 7th and 15th). Lightning damage or falling unconscious dispels it. Its saves use your highest jutsu save DC.

activities.label: Carbon cloud
activities.text: Action in the Dust Veil: a 20-foot cube within 60 feet, lightly obscured, 1 minute. Starting a turn in it. Failure: Envenomed (critical Potency II: also Blinded until the end of its following turn).

activities.label: Potency I: Volatile
activities.text: Once per turn, damaging a creature with a Jiton Hijutsu.

rules.text: The cloud counts as 2 ranks of Volatile. Potency II: two points, heavily obscured and difficult terrain.

activities.label: Gold wave
activities.text: Once per turn, Bonus action: a 20-foot cone (40-foot at Potency II). Failure: Grappled until the end of its turn (Potency II: also Heavy and Slowed until the end of its following turn).

activities.label: Potency I: Heavy
activities.text: Once per turn, a creature fails a save against your Jiton Hijutsu: Heavy until the start of your next turn.

activities.label: Iron aura
activities.text: A creature of your choice casts a Mobility jutsu within your 10-foot aura. Failure: if it has Bleed, it suffers Bleed as if its turn started.

rules.text: Potency I: once per turn, a failed save against your Jiton Hijutsu adds a rank of Bleed. Potency II: 10 minutes coats the particles in a poison; failing creatures can suffer it instead.

activities.label: Salt in the wounds
activities.text: A creature below its maximum hit points starting its turn within 15 feet. Failure: it loses its reaction or takes 1d6 earth or poison per rank of its Physical conditions.

activities.label: Potency I: Brined
activities.text: Once per turn, damaging a creature with a Jiton Hijutsu.

rules.text: Potency II: Brined creatures can't regain hit or chakra points, the DC to end their conditions is 5 higher, and their conditions count as B-Rank.

activities.label: Potency I: Unstable
activities.text: In the stance, a creature takes damage from your Jiton Hijutsu.

roll.note: Bonus action, once per rest: cast your chosen jutsu (Beast Imitating Art: Predator, Sealing Art: Inanimate Puppet, Beast Imitating Art: Oni Twins, Earth Release: Mud Wolf or Stone Dragon) at A-Rank for no chakra (up to two summons).

rules.text: In the Dust Veil: DR against attack damage equal to your highest ability modifier (add it while the stance is active).
A 40-foot cube within 60 feet for 1 minute: creatures moving in it reveal themselves to you; invisible creatures in it become visible. Upcast: +10 feet per rank; A-Rank lasts 1 hour.

activities.label: Dust Arm
activities.text: On casting and as a Bonus action: each arm attacks a different creature within 10 feet of it (and can move 30 feet).

activities.label: Dust Arm: on a hit
activities.text: Failure: Grappled by the arm (Strength or Dexterity save at the end of each of its turns).

rules.text: Two arms; +1 at B and S.

activities.label: Magnet Release: Dust Coat
activities.text: Starts the jutsu's Amp at the rank it was cast at.

activities.label: Dust Coat: barrier
activities.text: At the start of each of your turns (10 from C-Rank).

rules.text: The Amp gives +2 AC and +2 DR (+1 each at B and S); A-Rank or higher lasts 1 hour. Ends early in Heavy armor or as a bonus action. Choose one Barrier when you have two.
A 20-foot cube within 60 feet: creatures of your choice in it are immune to environmental hazards and difficult terrain and can walk across it, even over a ravine.

activities.label: Dust Particle Drizzle

tiers.critSuccess: Critical Success: half of 1d12 earth and 1d12 piercing.
tiers.success: Success: half, and Dazzled until the end of its next turn.
tiers.failure: Failure: 1d12 earth and 1d12 piercing, Sealed and Bruised.
tiers.critFailure: Critical Failure: as a failure, with 2d12 of each.

activities.text: Creatures of your choice in a 30-foot cone.

activities.label: Drizzle: damage
activities.text: Halve it on a success.

rules.text: C-Rank: +1 rank of Sealed; B-Rank: +10 feet to the cone; A-Rank: +1 rank of Dazzled; S-Rank: +10 more feet.

activities.label: Dust Particle World
activities.text: Creatures of your choice entering first on a turn or starting there, in the 40-foot sphere. Failure: the damage, Restrained for the duration and 2 ranks of Sealed; success: half. Already Grappled or Restrained by your Jiton Hijutsu or features and failing: also Stunned until the end of its next turn.

rules.text: Difficult terrain; Perception through it at disadvantage.

activities.label: Dust Shield (Action)
activities.text: You or a willing creature within 30 feet: a Barrier until it moves or drops to 0.

activities.label: Dust Shield (Reaction)
activities.text: You or an ally within 30 feet takes damage: a Barrier until the start of its next turn.

rules.text: The Barrier resists cold and earth, is vulnerable to lightning. B-Rank or higher: the protected creature can't be moved against its will.

activities.label: Dust Shuriken Storm
activities.text: 4 more chakra each: another attack on a different creature (up to three more). A critical hit refunds that attack's chakra.

rules.text: B-Rank: one extra attack can repeat a creature; A-Rank or higher: +1d10 of each; S-Rank: one roll against up to 4 creatures' AC.

activities.label: Dust World Order

tiers.success: Success: half of 6d6 earth and Staggered.

activities.text: A 20-foot radius within 60 feet.

activities.label: Dust World Order: damage
activities.text: Halve it on a success.

rules.text: Upcast: +10 feet to the area per rank.

activities.label: Gathering Assault
activities.text: A creature: it lands on top of the target.

activities.label: Gathering Assault: weapons
activities.text: Creatures within 40 feet wielding metallic weapons. Failure: the weapon merges into the structure; a target that was hit is also Restrained under it (resave at the end of each of its turns).

rules.text: On a space: destroys the ground (falls through if under 5 feet thick); a 15 by 20-foot structure lands. Upcast: +1 structure or attack per rank.

A.label: Gathering Assault
A.text: A creature: it lands on top of the target.

A.label: Gathering Assault: weapons
A.text: Creatures within 40 feet wielding metallic weapons. Failure: the weapon merges into the structure; a target that was hit is also Restrained under it (resave at the end of each of its turns).

S.label: Gathering Assault
S.text: A creature: it lands on top of the target.

S.label: Gathering Assault: weapons
S.text: Creatures within 40 feet wielding metallic weapons. Failure: the weapon merges into the structure; a target that was hit is also Restrained under it (resave at the end of each of its turns).

activities.label: Imperial Dust Funeral
activities.text: A 60-foot cone. Failure: the damage, Restrained, Weakened, Bruised and pushed to its end. Creatures Grappled or Restrained by your Jiton Hijutsu or features fail automatically and take the damage as if vulnerable.

rules.text: Not again until the end of your following turn.

activities.label: Magnetic Polarization
activities.text: A 10-foot cube on a point within 60 feet. Failure: for the duration the first weapon attack against it each turn has advantage, and it gains a rank of Sealed.

rules.text: Upcast: +5 feet to the cube per rank.

roll.note: Action, 10 minutes: a floating 5-foot-radius disc (10 feet at 15th), 40-foot fly speed, up to 4 creatures or 500 lbs (8 or 1,000 at 15th). Riding it, use its speed.

rules.text: You gain the other nature release (Earth or Wind; set it on the sheet); Earth or Wind Release jutsu can deal Wind or Earth damage respectively.

activities.label: Magnetic Surge
activities.text: Bonus action, 1 minute, once per rest: a 40-foot radius of dominion.

rules.text: Up to 6 Magnetic Charges. In the Surge: your Jiton Hijutsu and Dust Veil abilities can originate anywhere you see in the radius; creatures of your choice treat it as difficult terrain; once per turn, forced movement +10 feet; 2 Magnetic Charges at the start of your turns (press Gain once more).

roll.note: A metallic weapon attacks in range: subtract this from the attack.
A metallic weapon attacks in range: its damage die is 1 step smaller (2 at 7th, 3 at 15th), or one fewer die.

activities.label: Magnetic Snatch
activities.text: Bonus action: an unwilling creature's held weapon in range (one more creature at 7th and 15th). Failure: the weapon is pulled to you.

activities.label: Magnetic Vectors
activities.text: 2 charges and your reaction: a metallic ranged attack in range is redirected; on a hit, the original attack's effect lands on the new target.

activities.label: Magnetic Puppetry
activities.text: Action, 3 charges: a creature wielding a metallic weapon. Failure: it attacks the closest creature of your choice with its weapon's damage + 2d8 (+1d8 and +1 creature at 7th, 11th and 15th).

roll.note: Once per turn, casting a Jiton Hijutsu (the start of your turn adds one by itself).

rules.text: Magnetic Charges: +1 at the start of each of your turns and once per turn casting a Jiton Hijutsu (the buttons), up to 4 (6 at 15th); each lasts 1 minute. Spend once per turn.
The Dust Veil chakra stance: your particle type's benefits (the Dust Veil options: Carbon, Gold, Iron, Salt, Sand). Lightning damage or falling unconscious dispels it.
After a short or long rest, resistance to two of bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, earth or wind damage from attacks until your next short rest (add them on the sheet).
